title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer
description:
Senior Cloud Security Engineer


£90,000-£100,000 + Benefits


Fully Remote - United Kingdom


Join a rapidly growing AI technology business as they make their first dedicated Cloud Security hire.


This is an opportunity to take ownership of security across a modern cloud-native platform, helping protect valuable customer data, intellectual property and AI infrastructure while shaping the future security strategy of the organisation.


The Company


Our client is a high-growth technology business building advanced AI-powered products used by global enterprise customers. Operating at the forefront of generative AI, digital content and media technology, they've experienced significant recent growth and are continuing to scale both their platform and engineering teams.


Security is becoming an increasingly important part of that journey, creating an opportunity for an experienced engineer to establish best practices, influence technical direction and build a security capability from the ground up.


The Role


Working within the Infrastructure & DevOps team, you'll become the primary security specialist for the business, partnering closely with platform, engineering and machine learning teams.


You'll help strengthen cloud and infrastructure security across a modern, cloud-native environment, taking ownership of areas such as access management, platform security, DevSecOps practices, data protection and security automation.


Key responsibilities include:


  • Leading cloud security initiatives across a large-scale production environment.
  • Improving security controls across infrastructure, platforms and containerised workloads.
  • Establishing best practices around identity, access management and Zero Trust security.
  • Driving secure Infrastructure-as-Code and DevSecOps approaches.
  • Enhancing security monitoring, vulnerability management and incident response capabilities.
  • Implementing solutions to protect sensitive customer data, proprietary technology and business-critical assets.
  • Helping shape the long-term security strategy as the company continues to scale.


Your Skills & Experience


We're interested in speaking with engineers who have:


  • Several years of experience within Cloud Security, Security Engineering, Platform Security or a similar discipline.
  • Strong knowledge of public cloud environments and modern infrastructure platforms.
  • Experience securing Kubernetes, containers or distributed production systems.
  • A solid understanding of IAM, networking and security best practices.
  • Exposure to Infrastructure-as-Code and modern DevOps environments.
  • The confidence to operate as a subject matter expert and take ownership of security decisions.


Experience within SaaS, FinTech, Enterprise Software, AI, Media Technology or other security-conscious environments would be beneficial, but we're open to a variety of backgrounds.


What's On Offer


  • £90,000-£100,000 salary.
  • Fully remote working.
  • The chance to become the first dedicated security specialist within the team.
  • Significant ownership and autonomy.
  • Exposure to cutting-edge AI, cloud and platform engineering challenges.
  • The opportunity to influence security standards across a fast-growing technology business.


How To Apply


To find out more, please apply via the link below or contact Alfie Turner for a confidential discussion.
